content.short: RareSkills Bootcamp turns junior blockchain engineers into seniors through a rigorous Web3 engineering training program.
content.description: Finding senior blockchain engineers remains a major hurdle, and the path to developing those skills is often unclear. RareSkills Bootcamp answers this gap with the longest, most rigorous Web3 engineering training program available. Each cohort is capped at five participants, and every engineer receives weekly, one-on-one instruction from an expert mentor. For organizations seeking to scale blockchain expertise, RareSkills can train their engineers directly. Learn more by visiting our website.
